description: cinatra#2024 (S9 program acceptance) — the chat-surface invoker-suite closeout row, unblocked by cinatra#2256's merge (the chat connectorKey-derivation fix). This is a RE-CITE of #2256's own merged resolver-level test — no new test is written here, per this program's own do-not-duplicate-assertions discipline; this row folds that already-proven evidence into S9's own closing checklist ('Suites green: invoker — chat surface').

verdicts.item: invoker-suite-chat-surface (wordpress_site_tool_call / wordpress_site_tools_list reachable from chat via the real resolver, explicit instanceId, no durable pin)

detail.whyThisIsTheRightEvidence: wordpress_site_tool_call/wordpress_site_tools_list are the two model-visible primitives that call invokeSiteTool/listSiteTools directly (packages/sdk-extensions/src/connector-instance-invoker-contract.ts's own header comment). This suite drives invoker.invokeSiteTool/invoker.listSiteTools end to end through the REAL resolveConnectorInstanceInvokerContext() under a chat-delegated ambient MCP request frame — never a mocked resolver — so it is direct proof of chat-surface reachability, not an adjacent policy-layer check.
assertionsAlreadyProvenThereNotRestatedH: POSITIVE: an explicit instanceId lets a chat actor reach a real dispatch (connectorKey host-derives, no pin, the live org-membership gate re-checks and allows)
NEGATIVE: no instanceId still fails closed (connector_key_underivable) before any authority check runs
NEGATIVE: a forged/other-tenant instanceId still fails closed (instance_org_mismatch) via the real, unmocked per-instance org-binding gate
NO DURABLE PIN: two calls from the same chat actor targeting different instances re-resolve and re-authorize independently — no cross-call reuse
REGRESSION GUARDS: agent_run and public_site_widget without a signed pin are unchanged — the fix is scoped to chat only
listSiteTools gets the identical treatment as invokeSiteTool, both positive and negative
detail.whatThisRowAdds: folds cinatra#2256's already-merged, already-CI-green evidence into S9's own closing checklist as its own named row — previously blocked on the chat connectorKey-derivation gap, now satisfied
detail.priorGap: before cinatra#2256, every chat-surface call to either primitive threw connector_key_underivable unconditionally — a real regression against the earlier perimeter-policy change that first allowlisted these two primitives for chat. The pre-fix ship-dark test only asserted the policy-layer allowlist, never the resolver, so it could not catch this.

localRun.result: 8 passed, 0 failed (re-run fresh at this evidence capture's own commit, confirming it still holds — not assumed from the original merge alone)
localRun.environment: local (operator box) — no live WordPress fixture required; this suite is fully mocked at the wire-transport boundary

provenance.hashingConvention: sha256OfFile from tests/e2e/wp-mcp-gateway/provenance.mjs — hashes computed fresh against the already-merged cinatra#2256 files as they stand in this branch's own tree, not copied from an unrelated capture
